subject.title: improve(control-ui): expose linear session positions in chat picker

question: Should maintainers land this narrow Control UI split-pane session selector accessibility affordance after resolving the current-main conflict?
rationale: The patch is focused and proven, but it has a protected maintainer label, user-facing accessibility wording, a dirty merge state, and only partial overlap with a broader accessibility product request.

options.title: Land Narrow Selector Slice
options.body: Refresh the branch, resolve conflicts, rerun required checks, and merge the row-number/current-session cue while leaving the broader accessibility issue open.

options.title: Request UX Wording Changes
options.body: Ask for different visible ordinal treatment or screen-reader phrasing before merge if maintainers want a different accessibility pattern.

options.title: Pause For Broader Design
options.body: Hold this PR until the linear persistent workspace direction is decided, accepting that the smaller picker improvement waits.

recommendation.title: Land Narrow Selector Slice
recommendation.body: Refresh the branch, resolve conflicts, rerun required checks, and merge the row-number/current-session cue while leaving the broader accessibility issue open.
